limitations: External MLB 2014 weights are not validated for LMB.
In-play uses one league contact mean across all counts and physical profiles; no contact-quality or HR model.
No runners, outs, park or weather adjustment; not RE24 or official hackathon xRunValue.
Ordinary two-strike fouls have zero value; foul bunts and other exceptions are not modeled.
Rounded published count expectations and constant contact value need not yield a zero league mean.
Count-only B1 is a reference, not an official baseline or new independent evaluation.
